method: Poppler pdftoppm at 110 dpi; each of six final page images opened and visually inspected by implementation agent

pages.observations: Title, source definitions, exact conjecture and draft/AI disclosure legible; no clipping.
Literal word, all occurrence positions and finite proof legible; no overlap.
All edge subwords and complete pair matrix legible, with bottom paragraph clear of footer.
Formal correspondence, archive hash, replay attribution and trust limits fit cleanly.
Related work, embargo limitation, generic SMT predecessor and modest scope fully visible.
Reproduction details, bibliography, DOI and source-retention evidence fit cleanly.
